vocab.definition: a group of hydrocarbons with similar boiling points.
hot at the bottom, cool at the top.
a vapour turns to liquid at its boiling point.

misconceptions.wrong: Fractional distillation is a chemical reaction.
misconceptions.right: It is a physical separation — no new substances.

misconceptions.wrong: Small molecules collect at the bottom.
misconceptions.right: Small, low-bp molecules rise to the cool top.

misconceptions.wrong: The column is the same temperature throughout.
misconceptions.right: It has a temperature gradient: hot below, cool above.
